description: Start a commercial playbook for one lead, opportunity, conversation or customer. The first step is dispatched immediately. Read the current step with playbook_get_run. Starting the same idempotencyKey twice returns the same run.

playbookId.description: Playbook id. An active version is used; if an inactive id is given, the active version with the same key is used.

title: playbook start

description: Read a playbook run: its status, the pinned playbook version, the steps and the index of the current step. Only the step at currentStepIndex may be acted on.
title: playbook get run

description: Report the outcome of the CURRENT step of a playbook run and move it to the next step. You may only advance the current step; you cannot skip or reorder steps. Send expectedStepIndex with the index you read from playbook_get_run. A stale index is rejected with 409, so retry after reading the run again.

outcome.description: done or skipped move on; failed ends the run.

title: playbook advance

description: Qualify a lead against the company qualification criteria (document 'qualification-criteria'). You supply the reasoning: for each criterion, set met to true, false or null and add a short note with the evidence. The service scores the result from the criteria weights, records the sources and stores the qualification. Missing criteria count as not met.

criterion.description: Criterion key from the criteria document.

met.description: true when the evidence meets the criterion, false when it does not, null when unknown.

title: lead qualify

description: Look up public information about a company from a domain or an email address (company, size, sector, signals and sources). Costs money: it is recorded as an enrichment cost. Use it only when the qualification needs company facts you do not have.

query.description: A domain (example.com) or an email address.

title: lead enrich

description: Propose a commercial decision for a human to resolve (approve a message send, approve a proposal, a price exception, discard a lead, escalate a customer, or raise an autonomy level). Declare the subject (kind and id), the subjectVersion you saw, and the effect each option will apply if chosen. A human resolves it; nothing is sent or changed until then.
title: decision create

description: Read one commercial decision: its status, options, declared effects and resolution.
title: decision get

description: Propose commitments found in one conversation. You read the messages and supply the candidates: who made the commitment (us or them), what was promised, an optional due date and your confidence from 0 to 1 with the supporting quote. The service normalizes and deduplicates them and stores them as proposed until a person or playbook confirms them.
title: commitments extract

description: Create a draft commercial proposal from an opportunity (scope, price, optional deposit, validity). Repeating the same idempotencyKey returns the existing proposal. The draft is not visible to the customer until proposal_send. A sent revision is immutable: any change creates a new revision with revision + 1, and the sent revision stays as it was.
title: proposal create

description: Send a draft proposal. via "link" returns the public URL for delivery; via "message" sends it through the message channel when available. Only draft revisions can be sent. A sent revision is immutable: any change creates a new revision with revision + 1, and the sent revision stays as it was.
title: proposal send

description: Read one proposal: status, revision, price, deposit, payment status and acceptance evidence. A sent revision is immutable: any change creates a new revision with revision + 1, and the sent revision stays as it was.
title: proposal get

description: Hand an accepted proposal (proposalId) or a sold opportunity (opportunityId plus title and acceptanceCriteria) to delivery: creates the project, the assignment with its acceptance criteria, installs the optional team, writes the brief and adds the handoff package comment. Idempotent and resumable: calling it again for the same source completes a partial handoff without duplicating the project or the assignment.
title: handoff to delivery

description: Read a recurring service agreement: its deliverables per period, status, renewal settings and the periods with their assignments and renewal ids.
title: agreement get

description: Record upsell suggestions derived from the conversations with a customer. This only records a suggestion for the account manager; it does not sell, price or send anything.
title: upsell suggest

description: Queue a stop motion video from an ordered list of same-company image assets (PNG, JPEG or WebP). Frame order is the array order. Camera motion is pan, zoom or none. Retry with the same idempotency key; poll media_get_job.
title: media stop motion

description: Queue speech for translated segments where each segment names its speaker and ElevenLabs voice. The caller supplies the translation; segments sharing a voiceId are synthesized together. Poll media_get_job.
title: media dub multivoice

description: Queue a voice track laid over a media project with the original audio ducked under the voice. Provide exactly one voice source: a script to synthesize (with voiceId) or an existing audio asset. Poll media_get_job.
title: media voiceover

description: Create a reusable single-file skill in the company library. Supply a complete SKILL.md whose name and description match the inputs. This saves the skill and shows a card; it does not assign the skill to any agent. Reuse idempotencyKey on retries.

markdown.description: Complete SKILL.md including name and description frontmatter and substantive instructions.

name.description: Lowercase skill name, matching SKILL.md frontmatter.

title: Create skill

description: Fallback only: discover Paperclip API operations when the available dedicated tools cannot express the task. Prefer dedicated tools for common operations; do not search before using them. For a persistent hire, first list_agents to reuse a suitable teammate. Search agent-hires for the hiring schema and agent-configurations for compatible adapter/runtime settings, then use call_api with the returned operationId. Supply role-specific instructionsBundle.files as a filename-to-content record. Use the returned agent.id for delegation and obey any pending approval. Provider helper threads are temporary workers, not Paperclip hires. If a hire response is uncertain, reconcile with list_agents before retrying.
title: Search the Paperclip API

description: Fallback only: call a discovered Paperclip API operation when dedicated tools lack the required operation or parameters. Uses the same route permissions as agent REST access. Prefer dedicated tools for common workflows; route denials still apply. For large text responses, read the returned artifact with GET /api/assets/{assetId}/content and responseText; follow nextOffsetBytes until null.

body.description: Request value matching the discovered schema. For JSON object or array requests, pass the object or array directly, never a JSON-encoded string. Strings are for text bodies or endpoints whose schema explicitly accepts a string.

path.description: File relative to the active issue workspace. Remote files must first be uploaded as an artifact.

operationId.description: Exact operationId returned by search_api, for example GET /api/projects/{id}. Do not guess identifiers.

responseText.description: GET only: return a bounded UTF-8 text window inline, including JSON as text, without saving another artifact. Offsets and limits are bytes. Use the returned nextOffsetBytes to continue; null means complete. Prefer reading a saved artifact for a stable snapshot. New live responses have a 1 GiB capture limit and a 4 GiB per-run capture budget. Existing larger assets remain readable in bounded pages. If a live response returns an artifact, continue on its content operation for a stable snapshot.

title: Call the Paperclip API

description: Reassign an existing task to another company agent. Read search_tasks first and supply its current assignee and statusVersion to prevent overwriting a concurrent change. Preserve the task, documents, dependencies, and blocked/backlog status. Active work is stopped before handoff. Use a stable idempotency key for retries. Cannot reassign this run’s own task, conversations, completed tasks, or pending reviews; use create_task for delegation from the current task.

Cannot combine repositoryIds/repositoryUrls with workspace. Reuse the idempotency key on retries.

repositoryIds.description: Authorized repository IDs from list_project_repositories; may contain multiple repositories.

repositoryUrls.description: Existing HTTPS GitHub repository URLs, including repos absent from the catalog.

assigneeActorId.description: Optional actor assignee. Mutually exclusive with assigneeUserId.

assigneeUserId.description: Company person ID from list_people. Mutually exclusive with assigneeActorId.

initialPlan.description: Remaining execution steps to persist as the task plan. Exclude completed planning, approval, and handoff steps; cite the source plan revision and approval. A copied plan is not a new approval gate.

projectId.description: Project identifier for the new task.

status.description: Initial status. Use backlog to save work without execution. Defaults to todo (blocked when dependencies are unresolved).

scheduledWakeIds.description: Wake identifiers scheduled by the operation.
